source: User-supplied Wave Race 64 USA revision 1 ROM on VENGEANCE
method: Original ADPCM decoding of sequence0/channel12 regular announcer percussion, logical bank2 resolving to physical bank2. Its112 drum slots contain95 populated selectors and17 null entries. Original sample/tuning/envelope/release combinations render to94 standalone mono PCM files, with one shared clip. Null entries remain silent; special sequence commands126/127 are not implemented by this bank. The ROM and raw banks remain private.
tools: Existing REA/Ghidra analysis on EVO X2
mix: Source tuning is baked into32kHz PCM without peak normalization. Original envelope uses two approximate7.5ms attack steps; sample playback is bounded by the original1200-tick note at200BPM/48PPQN (7.5seconds), approximate150ms release and5ms end fade. All admitted samples naturally end before the note limit. Voice pan64 is centered. Source priority and delayed-message byte logic is independently verified against original MIPS execution. Sequence12 polls every6 ticks (37.5ms); Web Audio starts commands at browser drain time and does not emulate sequencer phase or source reverb. Bus gain and resampling are browser adaptations. Missing files do not produce synthesized substitute speech or replay after loading.
